purpose: Verify if the server blindly echoes arbitrary Origin headers in Access-Control-Allow-Origin.
expected_secure_behavior: Server does not return Access-Control-Allow-Origin or returns only pre-approved trusted origins.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Server returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://attacker.untrusted.test and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.
remediation: Configure an explicit allowlist of trusted origins. Never use origin: (origin, callback) => callback(null, true) in production.

purpose: Test if the application accepts 'null' origin (common in sandboxed iframes and local file URIs).
expected_secure_behavior: Server rejects Origin: null without CORS headers.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Server returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: null with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.
remediation: Do not include 'null' in the allowed CORS origins list.

purpose: Detect insecure wildcard origin with credentials allowed.
expected_secure_behavior: Server does not pair wildcard with credentials.
remediation: If credentials are required, specify an exact origin from an allowlist.
